speaker: charlie
text: Before we wrap up today's show, we've got to mention the extraordinary rescue efforts happening in Laos right now. Cave divers have found five of seven villagers who've been trapped underground for over a week, and they're all alive.

speaker: alice
text: This story has echoes of that famous Thai cave rescue from 2018, and incredibly some of the same divers are involved. They're working around the clock to pump water out of the caves so these blokes can walk out safely rather than having to dive through flooded passages.

speaker: charlie
text: It's a reminder of what humans can achieve when we work together and refuse to give up on each other. Two people are still missing but the rescue teams aren't stopping until everyone's accounted for.

speaker: alice
text: That's the kind of story that restores your faith in humanity, doesn't it? From all of us here at ParkSyde Bright Side, thanks for joining us today. We'll be back tomorrow with more good news from around Australia and the world.

speaker: charlie
